hook.en: "Your parcel is stuck — click here to pay RM2.50." One click on a fake link like this can give scammers your bank details.
hook.bm: "Bungkusan anda tersekat — klik di sini untuk bayar RM2.50." Satu klik pada pautan palsu seperti ini boleh memberi penipu butiran bank anda.

bigIdeas.en: Common threats include phishing, malware (viruses, worms, trojans, ransomware) and weak passwords.
bigIdeas.bm: Ancaman lazim termasuk pancingan data (phishing), perisian hasad (virus, cecacing, trojan, perisian tebusan) dan kata laluan lemah.

bigIdeas.en: Everything you post forms a digital footprint that can be hard to erase.
bigIdeas.bm: Semua yang anda kongsi membentuk jejak digital yang sukar dipadam.

bigIdeas.en: Malaysian laws such as the Computer Crimes Act 1997 and the Personal Data Protection Act 2010 protect users and data.
bigIdeas.bm: Undang-undang Malaysia seperti Akta Jenayah Komputer 1997 dan Akta Perlindungan Data Peribadi 2010 melindungi pengguna dan data.

cells.en: Fake messages trick you into giving data
cells.bm: Mesej palsu memperdaya anda memberi data

cells.en: Check the sender; do not click unknown links
cells.bm: Semak pengirim; jangan klik pautan tidak dikenali

cells.en: Damages files; worms spread by themselves

cells.bm: Bersembunyi dalam atur cara yang kelihatan berguna
Muat turun daripada sumber dipercayai sahaja

definition.en: Fake emails, SMS or websites that steal personal information.
definition.bm: E-mel, SMS atau laman web palsu yang mencuri maklumat peribadi.

definition.en: Software designed to harm: viruses, worms, trojans, ransomware, spyware.
definition.bm: Perisian yang direka untuk memudaratkan: virus, cecacing, trojan, perisian tebusan, perisian intip.

definition.en: A second check, such as a code on your phone, after the password.
definition.bm: Semakan kedua, seperti kod di telefon, selepas kata laluan.

definition.en: The trail of data you leave online.
definition.bm: Jejak data yang anda tinggalkan dalam talian.

definition.en: Legal right of creators over their work.
definition.bm: Hak undang-undang pencipta ke atas karyanya.

definition.en: Using digital technology to hurt, threaten or embarrass someone.
definition.bm: Menggunakan teknologi digital untuk menyakiti, mengugut atau memalukan seseorang.

question.en: Which is the strongest password: "ali2010", "password", "Kucing#Biru!92" or "12345678"?
question.bm: Kata laluan manakah paling kuat: "ali2010", "password", "Kucing#Biru!92" atau "12345678"?

steps.en: Strong passwords are long and mix upper and lower case, numbers and symbols.
steps.bm: Kata laluan kuat panjang dan mencampurkan huruf besar, huruf kecil, nombor dan simbol.

steps.en: Avoid names, birth years and common words.
steps.bm: Elakkan nama, tahun lahir dan perkataan biasa.

prompt.en: A fake SMS asking you to click a link and enter your bank PIN is…
prompt.bm: SMS palsu yang meminta anda klik pautan dan memasukkan PIN bank ialah…

explanation.en: Banks never ask for your PIN by SMS.
explanation.bm: Bank tidak pernah meminta PIN melalui SMS.

prompt.en: Malware that locks your files and demands payment is…
prompt.bm: Perisian hasad yang mengunci fail dan menuntut bayaran ialah…

explanation.en: Backups reduce the damage.
explanation.bm: Sandaran mengurangkan kerosakan.

prompt.en: Which is the STRONGEST password?
prompt.bm: Kata laluan manakah PALING kuat?

explanation.en: Long + mixed characters.
explanation.bm: Panjang + aksara bercampur.

prompt.en: Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds…
prompt.bm: Pengesahan dua faktor (2FA) menambah…

explanation.en: Even if a password is stolen, the account stays protected.
explanation.bm: Walaupun kata laluan dicuri, akaun masih dilindungi.

options.en: a second check such as a code sent to your phone
options.bm: semakan kedua seperti kod yang dihantar ke telefon

options.en: a second password that is the same

prompt.en: Your digital footprint is…
prompt.bm: Jejak digital anda ialah…

explanation.en: Posts, comments, photos and searches all add to it.
explanation.bm: Hantaran, komen, gambar dan carian semuanya menambahnya.

options.en: the trail of data you leave online
options.bm: jejak data yang anda tinggalkan dalam talian

prompt.en: Repeatedly sending hurtful messages to a classmate online is…
prompt.bm: Menghantar mesej yang menyakitkan kepada rakan sekelas berulang kali dalam talian ialah…

explanation.en: Report it and do not reply.
explanation.bm: Laporkan dan jangan balas.

prompt.en: The Malaysian Personal Data Protection Act was passed in the year ______.
prompt.bm: Akta Perlindungan Data Peribadi Malaysia diluluskan pada tahun ______.

explanation.en: It controls how organisations handle personal data.
explanation.bm: Ia mengawal cara organisasi mengendalikan data peribadi.

prompt.en: Copying a classmate's essay from the internet and submitting it as your own is…
prompt.bm: Menyalin karangan rakan dari internet dan menghantarnya sebagai karya sendiri ialah…

explanation.en: Always credit your sources.
explanation.bm: Sentiasa nyatakan sumber.

prompt.en: Match each threat with its description.
prompt.bm: Padankan ancaman dengan huraiannya.

explanation.en: Different threats need different defences.
explanation.bm: Ancaman berbeza memerlukan pertahanan berbeza.

right.en: Hides inside a program that looks useful
right.bm: Bersembunyi dalam atur cara yang kelihatan berguna

prompt.en: Select ALL signs that an email may be phishing.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA tanda e-mel mungkin pancingan data.

explanation.en: When in doubt, contact the organisation through its official channel.
explanation.bm: Jika ragu-ragu, hubungi organisasi melalui saluran rasmi.

options.en: Urgent warnings like "Your account will be closed today!"
options.bm: Amaran mendesak seperti "Akaun anda akan ditutup hari ini!"

options.en: A message from your teacher about tomorrow's class sent through the school system
options.bm: Mesej guru tentang kelas esok melalui sistem sekolah

prompt.en: Why should you install software updates promptly?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah kemas kini perisian patut dipasang segera?

explanation.en: Outdated software is a common way in for malware.
explanation.bm: Perisian lapuk ialah laluan lazim bagi perisian hasad.

options.en: They fix security holes that attackers use
options.bm: Ia membaiki kelemahan keselamatan yang digunakan penyerang

options.en: They always make the device slower

prompt.en: Before posting a photo of your friends, you should…
prompt.bm: Sebelum memuat naik gambar kawan-kawan, anda patut…

explanation.en: Respect others' privacy.
explanation.bm: Hormati privasi orang lain.

prompt.en: Which information should you NOT share publicly online?
prompt.bm: Maklumat manakah TIDAK patut dikongsi secara terbuka dalam talian?

explanation.en: Personal identifiers can be used for fraud.
explanation.bm: Pengenal peribadi boleh digunakan untuk penipuan.

options.en: Your IC number and home address
Your school's name in a club achievement post
options.bm: Nama sekolah dalam hantaran pencapaian kelab

prompt.en: Gaining unauthorised access to someone else's computer is an offence under Malaysia's…
prompt.bm: Mengakses komputer orang lain tanpa kebenaran ialah kesalahan di bawah…

explanation.en: "Hacking" for fun is still a crime.
explanation.bm: "Menggodam" untuk suka-suka tetap jenayah.

prompt.en: Using a photo from the internet in your project is acceptable when…
prompt.bm: Menggunakan gambar dari internet dalam projek anda boleh diterima apabila…

explanation.en: Creative Commons and public-domain images are good choices.
explanation.bm: Imej Creative Commons dan domain awam ialah pilihan yang baik.

options.en: its licence allows it and you credit the creator
options.bm: lesennya membenarkan dan anda menyatakan pencipta

options.en: it is any photo found on Google

prompt.en: Arrange the steps if you receive a suspicious link from an unknown number.
prompt.bm: Susun langkah jika anda menerima pautan mencurigakan daripada nombor tidak dikenali.

explanation.en: In Malaysia, scams can be reported to the National Scam Response Centre at 997.
explanation.bm: Di Malaysia, penipuan boleh dilaporkan kepada Pusat Respons Scam Kebangsaan di talian 997.

items.en: Check with the organisation through its official website or hotline
items.bm: Semak dengan organisasi melalui laman web atau talian rasmi

prompt.en: A future employer searches your name online. Why does your digital footprint matter?
prompt.bm: Majikan masa depan mencari nama anda dalam talian. Mengapakah jejak digital anda penting?

explanation.en: Think before you post.
explanation.bm: Fikir sebelum memuat naik.

options.en: Old posts can affect how others judge your character
options.bm: Hantaran lama boleh mempengaruhi tanggapan orang terhadap peribadi anda

options.en: It does not matter at all

prompt.en: Which practice protects your school files BEST against ransomware?
prompt.bm: Amalan manakah PALING melindungi fail sekolah anda daripada perisian tebusan?

explanation.en: Backups let you restore files without paying.
explanation.bm: Sandaran membolehkan fail dipulihkan tanpa membayar.

options.en: Keep regular backups on a separate drive or cloud, and keep software updated
options.bm: Simpan sandaran berkala dalam pemacu berasingan atau awan, dan kemas kini perisian
Gunakan kata laluan yang sama di semua tempat

prompt.en: A classmate shares a screenshot of a private chat to embarrass someone. What is the BEST response?
prompt.bm: Seorang rakan berkongsi tangkap layar perbualan peribadi untuk memalukan seseorang. Apakah tindakan PALING baik?

explanation.en: Bystanders can stop cyberbullying.
explanation.bm: Pemerhati boleh menghentikan buli siber.

options.en: Do not share it further, support the victim and report it to a teacher
options.bm: Jangan kongsi lagi, sokong mangsa dan laporkan kepada guru

prompt.en: Why does the Personal Data Protection Act 2010 matter to ordinary users?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah Akta Perlindungan Data Peribadi 2010 penting kepada pengguna biasa?

explanation.en: Users have rights over how their data is used.
explanation.bm: Pengguna mempunyai hak terhadap penggunaan data mereka.

options.en: It requires organisations to collect and use personal data responsibly
options.bm: Ia mewajibkan organisasi mengumpul dan menggunakan data peribadi secara bertanggungjawab

options.en: It allows anyone to sell your data
options.bm: Ia membenarkan sesiapa menjual data anda
